chapter.title: Chapter 1
chapter.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.Moved: or, brooded
And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

chapter.title: A Psalm of David.
chapter.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

verse.q: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

chapter.verse: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
